hearthandharvest.jei.info.watering_can: Hold fertilizer in the off hand and use the can to load it, one item per use (16 max, one kind at a time). Use it on a water source to fill it (16). Using it on a crop or other bone-mealable block spends one water and one fertilizer and applies bone meal to the 3x3 area around it. Using it on a crop or soil also soaks the farmland or Fertile Soil in the 3x3; with no fertilizer, or nothing left to grow, that costs one water. It also puts out fire and lit campfires for one water.
